name: Result reader
author: wizard
description: When a background task finishes, a fixed private model reads how it actually ended and decides how it reaches you: waiting on you (with a short plain ask and any choices the reply offered), a result, or a quiet note for the next sweep, and whether it is urgent enough for the alert rules. The agent's own status line becomes a hint, so a task that forgot it, or said done when it failed, still lands right. Only your private router model is ever asked; without one nothing changes. Read by the Agent Service (wizard-agent-service issue 630); nothing in the shell changes until it is on.
